description: This PHP source file defines the COD (Cash on Delivery) payment method model for the OpenCart e-commerce platform. It implements the logic to determine if the COD payment option should be available based on the address, cart contents, and configuration settings.

classes.name: COD
classes.description: Represents the Cash on Delivery payment method; extends the core Model class and provides method to retrieve available payment options.

methods.name: getMethods
methods.description: Determines whether the COD payment method is available based on cart contents, shipping, address, and configuration; returns an array with payment method details if available, or empty if not.
